$comment: Each declared migration step (plan section 3.4) and what feeds it. status: seeded (the seed door named writes it), pending (a seed is planned but not written yet), unheld (the old release cannot hold it).

agent:move-http-credentials-to-secrets.note: heavy workflows are created with an empty DSL: no HTTP node credentials yet

agent:backfill-versions.note: needs Agent rows without AgentVersion rows, as the previous release wrote them

analytics:fill-lwql-project-keys.note: projects; not in plan 3.4, confirm the input

annotation:record-trace-annotations.note: needs a trace id per project; heavy writes none (seed project only, product.go)

authz:engine.note: was the ops-held authz-engine migration; judge no organization finalized on the old image is migrated again

automation:reconcile-slack-claims.note: one webhook connection per organization; paused triggers not yet written

automation:unwrap-trigger-json-text.note: needs Trigger rows whose filters or actionParams hold JSON text, as the previous release saved them; no seed writes one yet

billing:fill-seat-change-organizations.note: 12 subscriptions in ACTIVE, PENDING, FAILED and CANCELLED

billing:record-usage-billing-catch-up.note: not in plan 3.4; needs usage traffic in the window

data-retention:keep-control-plane-events.note: retention rules set per heavy organization

dataset:move-content-to-object-storage.note: heavy creates the dataset by REST with no rows yet; rows in Postgres need a row door (REST rows route)

evaluator:backfill-versions.note: needs Evaluator rows without EvaluatorVersion rows, as the previous release wrote them

identity:identifier-backfill.note: was identity-d01-identifier-backfill; judge no user finalized on the old image is migrated again

ops:copy-identity-authz-migration-state.note: background copy of the finished and rolled-back rows and enrolments of the five moved migrations; judge counts match the old table

ops:recopy-identity-authz-migration-stat.note: rows the old image changed after the copy, and accounts identity reopened, reach the new steps

trace:send-month-trace-ids.note: spans this month and last; C4 holds the private target

governance:migrate-anomaly-webhook-desti.note: no headless door on the old image: SQL, flagged

governance:record-coding-assistant-billi.note: codingAgents router only reads on the old image: SQL, flagged

governance:replay-cost-charges.note: pulled usage has no headless door: SQL, flagged

authz:carry-over-engine-switch.note: finalized and rolled-back authz-engine rows on the old image; judge each organization's engine is unchanged after the carry-over

identity:carry-over-sign-in-switch.note: finalized and rolled-back identifier-backfill rows on the old image; judge each user's sign-in path is unchanged after the carry-over

instant-eval:copy-judge-spend.note: not in plan 3.4; confirm judge spend is written by the old evaluation path

licensing:copy-organization-licenses.note: license.upload with the test licence; product.mjs marks it unseedable without one

model-provider:seal-plaintext-custom-key.note: main has no headless door for a plaintext custom key: SQL row not written yet

ops:checkup-canary-project.note: creates its own hidden system organization and project; nothing to seed

ops:copy-automation-migration-state.note: written by main itself at boot; nothing to seed

ops:seed-platform-operators.note: needs ADMIN_EMAILS operators; cloud profile sets none

project:record-created-facts.note: projects made by main onboarding in each heavy organization

prompt:seed-tags-for-untagged-organizati.note: prompts created by REST in 12 organizations, none tagged

scenario:close-stalled-runs.note: needs open scenario runs at the cut; heavy writes scenarios, not runs

scim:replay-sso-connection-view.note: SSO connection and SCIM state by SQL

trace:track-updated-at-index-materialisa.note: about 300k spans through the OTLP door

upcast:entitlement:lw.usage.month_counte.note: branch-era event type, never written by a release; the upcast-events overlay (L5) injects it

user:lower-case-stored-addresses.note: needs mixed-case addresses and one case-only twin; judge every other address lower-cased and the twin listed in the step report, not renamed

user:record-created-facts.note: also re-states standing: 400 users in active, deactivated, unconfirmed and never-signed-in states

workflow:move-http-credentials-to-secret.note: heavy workflows are created with an empty DSL: no HTTP node credentials yet

authz legacy import.note: memberships; custom roles still to add for C2
